Gemini wants a deal to complete a set but giving them St. James only gets them partway since they'd still need New York from Grok. I'm noticing pink is incomplete too—if I buy Virginia I could complete that set myself, and I'm also checking who owns the red properties.

Instead of chasing those trades, maybe I just propose Grok a straightforward swap: St. James for North Carolina plus some cash. That gives Grok two oranges but no complete set since Gemini holds Tennessee, while I'd get two greens and just need Pacific. It's a reasonable offer even with Grok's cash advantage, so I'll propose St. James for NC plus $50.
